cohort: Singleton pregnant women who delivered at a tertiary care center between July 2023 and September 2023, excluding those with multiple pregnancies, congenital anomalies, or unwillingness to participate.
finding: The prevalence of breech presentation was 6.26%, with maternal and fetal complications each occurring in 9.28% of cases.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 18.56% of the cases.
